description: The line plot illustrates the training loss over time for two methods—Vanilla and SepLLM—during the training of large language models. The x-axis represents the training time in seconds, ranging from 0 to 250,000, with major tick marks at intervals of 50,000. The y-axis represents the loss, scaled from 2.40 to 2.75, with grid lines at 0.05 intervals. The Vanilla method is represented by a purple line with triangle markers, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 and steadily decreasing to around 2.48 by the end of the training period. The SepLLM method is shown as a red line with circle markers, beginning at a similar loss of about 2.75 and also decreasing, but reaching a loss of approximately 2.47 by the end. A green dashed horizontal line is drawn at a loss of 2.48, indicating a threshold or target level. A vertical green dashed line at 200,000 seconds marks the point where the SepLLM loss intersects this threshold, and a label "1.26×" with a double-headed arrow indicates that SepLLM reaches this loss level 1.26 times faster than Vanilla, which reaches the same loss level at a later time.
